summary.pack_description:
Collect unforgettable career beginnings with the Opening Ice 2025-26 Debut LE Pack! The Opening Ice 2025-26 set chronicles the first NHL career milestones from highly anticipated 2025-26 rookies. Featuring first goals and first wins, these highlights capture moments that these players will never forget as they forge their future in the league. Featuring Beckett Sennecke, Matthew Schaefer, Zeev Buium, Matvei Gridin, Sam Rinzel, and more!

Each pack contains 1 highlight from Opening Ice 2025-26, 2 mystery Core highlights from Base 2025-26 (40%), Fresh Sweaters 2025-26 (40%), or Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s (20%), 1 mystery highlight that could be from Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (36%), Opening Ice 2025-26 (30%), Base 2025-26 (10%), Fresh Sweaters 2025-26 (10%), Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s (10%), or Cause for a Celly: 2000s (4%), and 1 mystery highlight that could be from Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (49.8%), Opening Ice 2025-26 (20%), Opening Ice: Icons (20%), Cause for a Celly: 2000s (10%), or The Greatest Achievements (<1%).

release.name: Opening Ice 2025-26 Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sweepstakes: Each pack purchased from the NHL Breakaway Drops page (limit 10 per user) is an entry for the chance to win a trip for two to the NHL Winter Classic®, including airfare and lodging! Ends Nov 28, 2025 at 11:59:59 pm ET. Details

 

Sale Starts: Tuesday, Nov 11 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

 

Price: $39 USD

# Packs Available: 500 packs total. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

 

Purchase Limit: Five (5) pack limit per person for the first 6 hours; limit increased to thirty (30) pack limit per person afterwards. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 5

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • One (1) highlight from Opening Ice 2025-26 (Rare #/250)
  • Two (2) highlights with the following probabilities:
    • 40% Base 2025-26 (Core #/1500)
    • 40% Fresh Sweaters 2025-26 (Core #/1500)
    • 20% Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 36% Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (Limited #/500)
    • 30% Opening Ice 2025-26 (Rare #/250)
    • 10% Base 2025-26 (Core #/1500)
    • 10% Fresh Sweaters 2025-26 (Core #/1500)
    • 10% Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s (Core #/1500)
    • 4% Cause for a Celly: 2000s (Epic #/100)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 49.8% Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (Limited #/500)
    • 20% Opening Ice 2025-26 (Rare #/250)
    • 20% Opening Ice: Icons (Rare #/250)
    • 10% Cause for a Celly: 2000s (Epic #/100)
    • 0.2% The Greatest Achievements (Legendary #/10)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be processed via Stripe. 

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Highlights List
  • Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s, Series 3 - Preview
  • Base 2025-26, Series 3 - Preview
  • Fresh Sweaters 2025-26, Series 3 - Preview
  • Fresh Sweaters: Legacy, Series 3 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Icons, Series 3 - Preview
  • Opening Ice 2025-26, Series 3 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: 2000s, Series 3 - Preview
  • The Greatest Achievements, Series 3 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 3 highlights will only be distributed during Series 3, which ends prior to the start of the 2026-27 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Opening Ice 2025-26
summary.description: Collect history with Opening Ice 2025-26 Rare set. This seasonal installment that chronicles the first NHL career milestones from from highly-anticipated 2025-26 rookies. Featuring first goals and first wins, these highlights capture moments these players will always remember as they forge their future in the league.

summary.name: Base 2025-26
summary.description: Gear up for a season-long thrill ride with Base 2025-26! This Core set is packed with can’t-miss moments: from electrifying goals and crisp apples to heavy hits, clutch defensive plays, and jaw-dropping goalie saves. Whether it’s a game-breaking snipe, a tape-to-tape gem, or a showstopping glove save, each highlight brings you the very best of hockey action!

summary.name: Fresh Sweaters 2025-26
summary.description: Celebrate the excitement of a fresh start with the Fresh Sweaters 2025-26 Core set, featuring players making their mark with their new NHL teams. Each highlight captures a standout moment—whether it's a snipe, an apple, a great defensive play, a hit, or a jaw-dropping save. Relive the impact of players as they introduce themselves to new fans and teammates, setting the tone for the next chapter in their careers and defining their journey with a new franchise.

summary.name: Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s
summary.description: Celebrate the players who brought heart and soul to the ice with the Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s set! Relive great moments from fan-favorite players whose passion and grit defined their teams. These highlights showcase the unforgettable energy and excitement of 80s and 90s hockey.

summary.name: The Greatest Achievements
summary.description: Hockey’s history is rich with legendary players, unforgettable plays, and cherished memories. Yet every so often, something truly extraordinary occurs—like a record-shattering milestone or a Stanley Cup–winning goal from a franchise icon. These achievements capture the hockey world and become timeless pieces of the sport’s legacy. The Greatest Achievements honors these moments as part of the NHL Breakaway collection.
